note: Regenerate with: npx tsx scripts/design-calibration.ts (or --manifest-only to rebuild this file from the committed PNGs without re-shooting them). Expected verdicts are the point of the fixture; do not edit them to match a gate run.
scope: Calibrated 2026-11-04 (run 1837): 10/10 agreement, no overlap. Trusted BLOCK is licensed for layout geometry, type-role, contrast and token/palette classes ONLY. Imagery, interest floor, theme expression, day-over-day distinctness and motion have no fixture here and keep issuing withheld-BLOCK REVISE.

entries.carries: A rail header at the 375 floor after the #18637 fix: the heading owns a full-width row, the See-all drops onto its own row below it with its whitelist arrow intact.
entries.rule: doctrine §2 (type hierarchy), CTA whitelist (the arrow is part of the label)

entries.carries: The primary mobile navigation at 375 after the #18637 fix: every label renders at its natural width inside a horizontal scroller, in DM Sans, with the account tab pinned outside the scroller.
entries.rule: doctrine §2 (DM Sans for nav, labels, CTA text), mobile-first at 375

entries.carries: A storefront rail at 1440 in v3 chrome: flat paper-2 cards on a single plum-soft ground, each carrying the hairline border-line the doctrine requires, with no drop shadow and no second ground inside the band.
entries.rule: doctrine §1 (one ground per band), §3 (hairline border-line on cards, never a shadow; no old-cream grounds), §5 (card system)
knownDeviations: §4.4: card 5 (nixie-rechargeable-wand-massager-ombre-metallic) renders its retail carton as card art.
§6: the card brand eyebrow is body sans ink-3, not mono ink-4 (ProductCarousel.tsx:397).

entries.carries: The Meet Emma band at 1440: editorial serif display against body copy in DM Sans, generous vertical rhythm, a single tinted ground.
The ink closer band at 1440: white display type on bg-ink, one plum emphasis word lifted with .em-on-dark (~6.75:1), coral CTA measured at 5.51:1 white-on-coral.
entries.rule: doctrine §2 (exactly one emphasis word per headline), WCAG AA floor (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large display)

entries.carries: The rail header collision: the heading text ends on the same baseline as the See-all CTA with no vertical separation, so the CTA reads as a continuation of the sentence.
entries.rule: doctrine §2 (type hierarchy must be legible as hierarchy), mobile-first at 375

entries.carries: The primary mobile navigation rendered as one run-on glyph string: seven labels squeezed into slices narrower than themselves, with inter-word gaps indistinguishable from inter-letter gaps.
entries.rule: mobile-first at 375 (CLAUDE.md), doctrine §2 (labels must read as labels)
entries.reinstates: nav[aria-label="Browse categories"] button { flex: 1 1 0% !important; min-width: 0 !important; padding-left: 0 !important; padding-right: 0 !important; }

entries.carries: The primary navigation set in the display serif, where doctrine §2 assigns DM Sans. The band looks deliberate and is a type-system violation.
entries.rule: doctrine §2 (Newsreader for display, DM Sans for nav / labels / CTA text)
entries.reinstates: nav[aria-label="Browse categories"], nav[aria-label="Browse categories"] * { font-family: Newsreader, Georgia, serif !important; }

entries.carries: Plum emphasis on an ink ground without the .em-on-dark lift: roughly 2.5:1, so the emphasis word is the least legible word in the headline it is meant to emphasise.
entries.rule: mission brief §2 (plum on dark always uses .em-on-dark), WCAG AA floor per doctrine (3:1 large display)

entries.carries: Stale v2 card chrome on a v3 storefront rail: rounded corners, a drop shadow and a cream border against the flat-on-paper card system the doctrine locks.
entries.rule: doctrine §1 and §5 (flat coral on white paper, hairline frames, no drop shadows, no cream grounds)
entries.reinstates: section:has(> div > div.flex.flex-wrap.items-end.justify-between.gap-4.mb-6) a[href^="/products/"] { border-radius: 16px !important; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(26,20,24,0.18) !important; border: 1px solid #EFECE4 !important; background: #FAF4EA !important; padding: 10px !important; }
